try: load_klines("BTC-USDT","1h","2026-09-28","2026-09-30",cache_dir=tempfile.mkdtemp(),fetch=k)
except KlineGapError as e: print("spot mid refusal gaps:", [(str(g.start),str(g.end),g.candles,g.reason) for g in e.gaps], "frame", e.frame.height)
# futures 1d interval 5 days with page 2
k = KuCoin(futures_page=2); k.add_futures_synthetic(utc(2026,9,25), 5, 86_400_000)
f = load_klines("XBTUSDTM","1d","2026-09-25","2026-09-29",cache=False,fetch=k,market="futures"); print("futures 1d:", f.height, "calls", len(k.calls))
